שני ילדים, ברכת חנוכה אחת.

לא צריך לבחור מי מהם: מצרפים ילד נוסף לאותה מתנה.
ברכה לוואטסאפ, או חוברת צביעה להדפסה בבית.

במתנה מלומיבוק, בלי כרטיס אשראי.

למתנת החנוכה 👇

sources.title: מתנות אישיות לחנוכה בחינם
sources.supports: one gift: a personal greeting card to keep and share on WhatsApp, or a five-page colouring booklet to print at home; one clear face photo, first name, birth month and year (so the art fits the age); a second child can be added and a sentence of up to five words; no payment and no credit card; the page's example pictures show the card on grandparents' phones

sources.title: Hanukkah 2026 research page
sources.supports: every Hanukkah piece leads to the free gift page; after 05 / 12 only the gift; open: how long the gift takes, until when the page is open, how a two-child card looks

sources.title: Key dates
sources.supports: last order day for Hanukkah 05 / 12 / 2026; Hanukkah starts the evening of 04 / 12 and ends 12 / 12; Black Friday 27 / 11

_note: No real greeting card or colouring booklet has been made yet: the pictures here are real children with their books and the store's Hanukkah covers, as stand-ins. Replace the card or booklet pictures with a real gift made on the page before posting.
